conf.description: Linux syslog / journald auth / journald: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: linux-syslog / auth / journald. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Elastic Agent journald input (System integration), then logs-system.auth body grok). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
